missing_information_behavior: If any required safety or context information is missing, do not add positive recommendation score; request clarification or escalate.
safety_exclusions: Do not generalize results from strength training to every sport; no medical indication; assess renal context and product quality.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, pregnancy, minors, relevant medicines or abnormal renal markers require professional review.
population_and_context: Adults in repeated high-intensity intermittent sports; evidence is protocol- and sport-specific.
dose_constraints: No dose from rule; use only separately reviewed creatine monohydrate record.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS exercise fact sheet; assess exact performance endpoint, duration and training protocol. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
